critical_code_review_comments: Refactoring quality: server.py (224 lines) correctly splits into 8 routers, all imports work. AdminDashboard.js (676 lines) + LeadDrawer.js (740 lines) is a clean split.
New ML features: Revenue Forecasting uses numpy linear regression correctly with NaN/Inf safety checks. Agent Performance Matrix aggregates per-agent stats correctly.
Revenue forecast shows 'Declining' trend (-€1,084/day) - this is because few data points exist in a narrow window, not a bug.

AdminAnalytics.js: The entire RevenueForecastChart and AgentMatrix components have hardcoded Portuguese text (not using t() translation keys). Low priority since these are new features but should be translated.
LeadDrawer.js and AdminDashboard.js have duplicated constants (STATUS_OPTIONS, STATUS_STYLES, STATUS_KEY_MAP, fmt, fmtDate) - consider moving to a shared utils file.

rca_of_issues.hardcoded_pt_in_new_ml_components: RevenueForecastChart and AgentMatrix in AdminAnalytics.js were added as new visual features but the developer hardcoded Portuguese labels instead of using the existing t() translation system. Fix: add t() translation keys for all UI strings in these components.
rca_of_issues.duplicate_constants: LeadDrawer.js was extracted from AdminDashboard.js but the constants (STATUS_OPTIONS, STATUS_STYLES, fmt, etc.) were copied rather than extracted to a shared module. This is a code quality issue but not a functional bug.
